name: What factors can make a Comparative Market Analysis more complex?

mainEntity.name: What factors can make a Comparative Market Analysis more complex?

acceptedAnswer.text: Several factors can make a Comparative Market Analysis (CMA) more complex. These include properties with unique features, limited comparable sales in a specific area, rapidly changing market conditions, or properties that require significant repairs or renovations. For instance, analyzing a historic home in Coconut Grove or a luxury condo on Fisher Island with bespoke amenities requires a more nuanced approach than a typical suburban property due to fewer direct comparables and specialized market segments.
acceptedAnswer.description: Complex CMAs arise from unique properties, limited comparable sales, rapidly changing markets, or properties needing significant repairs.
